page.layout: One printed page of running text, one column; faint fragments of marginal notes in the left margin (not legible enough to transcribe); running head at top; page number at top right; catchword "ad-" at lower right of text block.

main_text.p: servitute circumspectio, à fraude dissimulatio: Virtutibus enim propinqua vitia, facile ipsarum virtutum compellatione dignatur humanæ mentis effæminata indulgentia: deinceps speciosò nomine tam libenter se fallens, ac si Naturam ipsam & Supremam Regulam unà pervertat. Adde quod sit alto infractoque animo generosum & par exercitium, aperto campo in Invidiam ire, liventem ejus aciem irretortis oculis ferre, & impavidum subsistere, & pedem consefrere, & regio huic oneri æquos humeros supponere, quod est audire malè, cùm facias bene. Nec prætεriri debet, quod effrænis & implacabilis est Invidia, ubi locum tecedere, ubi declinari se sentit: ex tuo timore suas vires dimetiens, ex tua imbecillitate sibi feritatem & audaciam sumens: proinde ad-
main_text.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are too faint and damaged to be read and are not transcribed. The text contains a few uncertain letters in the scan (e.g. "consefrere", "prætεriri" read as printed; the Greek-like ε in "prætεriri" is a misreading and should be "præterire" in print). Italic words: "audire malè, cùm facias bene".
